ValidationRule.description: Enforces the NEVER rule (ADR-001): the student and assigned advisor need no exception; the counseling center is allowed only as the Crisis exception; the advising queue only as the Advising Queue exception.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Recipient_Type__c, "Student"), ISPICKVAL(Recipient_Type__c, "Assigned Advisor")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Exception_Used__c, "None"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Recipient_Type__c, "Counseling Center"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Exception_Used__c, "Crisis"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Recipient_Type__c, "Advising Queue"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Exception_Used__c, "Advising Queue"))), ISBLANK(TEXT(Exception_Used__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Exception Used does not match Recipient Type. Student or Assigned Advisor: None. Counseling Center: Crisis. Advising Queue: Advising Queue.
